verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an inference engine, since batch inference over many prompts or a batch API is plausible. However, the evidence only documents continuous batching, an internal scheduling optimization for GPU utilization, not a user-facing way to submit or manage many items at once. A community comment even notes adding explicit batching support in their own client. No documented batch endpoint or bulk-submission workflow appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
